blocks.prompt: 3. Designing a low pass filter to remove high frequency noise from an audio signal, the filter is represented by the polynomial \(P(x) = x^3 + x^2 + 2x + 4\). Find whether \(x + 1\) is a factor.
blocks.explanation:
Low pass filter aur audio signal ki kahani sirf yeh batati hai ke polynomial kahan se aaya; asal sawal Factor Theorem ka test hai.
Find kya karna hai? Kya \(x + 1\), \(P(x) = x^3 + x^2 + 2x + 4\) ka factor hai?
Plan: \(x + 1\) ko \(x - (-1)\) likhein, \(P(-1)\) nikalein; zero aaye to factor, warna factor nahi.
Achhi baat yeh hai ke kahani jitni bhi lambi ho, maths sirf do lines ki hai: \(a\) dhoondo aur value nikalo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P(x) = x^3 + x^2 + 2x + 4\) aur divisor \(x + 1\).
Humein find karna hai: kya \(x + 1\) factor hai?
Tareeqa: Factor Theorem. Yeh theorem \(x - a\) ki shakal mein likha hota hai, is liye pehle divisor ko isi shakal mein laate hain.

Test karne wali value dhoondein
\[x + 1 = x - (-1)\]
\[\Rightarrow a = -1\]
Kyun: \(x + 1\) ko \(x - a\) se milayein to \(a = -1\) banta hai, \(+1\) nahi. Asaan tareeqa: factor ko zero ke barabar rakhein, \(x + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -1\).
Dhyan dein: sab se aam ghalti yahi hai ke bachche \(x + 1\) dekh kar \(P(1)\) nikal lete hain. \(P(1) = 8\) aata hai, jo ghalat test hai.

\(P(-1)\) nikalein
\[P(-1) = (-1)^3 + (-1)^2 + 2(-1) + 4\]
\[= -1 + 1 - 2 + 4\]
\[= 2\]
Kyun: \(-1\) ki odd power (1, 3, 5, ...) hamesha \(-1\) aur even power (2, 4, ...) hamesha \(+1\) hoti hai. Is liye \((-1)^3 = -1\) aur \((-1)^2 = +1\). Phir \(2 \times (-1) = -2\). Jama: \(-1 + 1 = 0\), \(0 - 2 = -2\), \(-2 + 4 = 2\). Remainder Theorem ke mutabiq yahi 2, \(x + 1\) se divide karne par remainder hai.

Natija nikalein
\[P(-1) = 2 \neq 0\]
Kyun: Remainder zero nahi, matlab \(x + 1\) poora poora divide nahi karta. Factor sirf woh hota hai jo bina kuch bache divide kare, is liye \(x + 1\) factor nahi hai.

Synthetic division se tasdeeq (\(a = -1\))
Coefficients \(1,\ 1,\ 2,\ 4\):
1 neeche utarein; \(1 \times (-1) = -1\), \(1 - 1 = 0\);
\(0 \times (-1) = 0\), \(2 + 0 = 2\);
\(2 \times (-1) = -2\), \(4 - 2 = 2\).
\[\text{Quotient} = x^2 + 2\]
\[\text{Remainder} = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Division bhi wahi remainder 2 deti hai. Aur ulta check: \((x + 1)(x^2 + 2) + 2 = x^3 + 2x + x^2 + 2 + 2 = x^3 + x^2 + 2x + 4\), bilkul \(P(x)\).
Dhyan dein: quotient \(x^2 + 2\) mein \(x\) wala term zero aaya, is liye woh likha nahi gaya. Agar remainder 0 hota to \(P(x) = (x + 1)(x^2 + 2)\) likh sakte, lekin yahan 2 bacha, to aisa likhna ghalat hoga.
blocks.final_answer: Nahi. \(P(-1) = 2 \neq 0\), is liye \(x + 1\), \(P(x)\) ka factor nahi hai (remainder 2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (PDF 307) mein is sawal ka jawab number 4 par hai: "\(x + 1\) is not a factor of \(p(x)\)", number 3 par nahi. Yeh hamare hal se milta hai. Key ke number is liye khisak gaye hain ke us mein 10 jawab hain aur sawal sirf 7.
